STATE-PRIMARY.rationale: Support owns no independent authoritative store; state remains owned by the caller Application and registered services.

STATE-INDEXES.rationale: Support owns no index or cache.

STATE-COUNTERS.rationale: Support exposes no module-owned generator, generation, revision or cursor.

STATE-NO-FALSE-PUBLISH.rationale: Support publishes no authoritative revision, event journal or mutation journal.

LIFE-SHUTDOWN.rationale: Support does not own application or backend shutdown; cleanup belongs to Core and concrete service owners.

LIFE-RETRY-CLEANUP.rationale: Support performs no fallible external cleanup operation and owns no cleanup retry state.

ATOMIC-SINGLE.rationale: Support does not mutate a single authoritative record; its stateful responsibility is composition publication.

ATOMIC-EXTERNAL.rationale: The service slot is fully prepared before external swap-chain creation; only no-throw map publication remains after backend success.

ATOMIC-RECONCILE.rationale: Support has no committed external transaction whose rollback can fail; failed factories publish no service.

PERSIST-SNAPSHOT.rationale: Support owns no persistent state or snapshot schema.

PERSIST-CONTINUITY.rationale: Support has no persistent generators, revisions, cursors or restore boundary.
